_comment: Email placeholders that are NOT personal data. Consumed by scripts/check/privacy.js (email findings matching an entry are dropped; everything else is a MED finding that FAILS the gate by default). Exact addresses go in `emails` (bot addresses as [local, domain] pairs in `emailPairs`, joined at load time); whole placeholder domains in `emailDomains`; `emailDomainSuffixes` covers reserved TLDs / bot-address domains. Adding a REAL personal address here is a leak — reviewers: treat additions as a policy change. Enforcer: scripts/check/privacy.test.js.
